name: Engineering Ontology
facts: System, equipment, property, calculation method and evidence are distinct types.
Relations have names: requires input, applies to, supported by, reviewed as.
A type is different from an instance; a connection is different from verified applicability.
Entry points equipment/method/evidence change the context path, not the facts.
seeds: Semantic atlas: topographic regions and typed routes map knowledge without a generic hub-and-spoke graph.
Relation loom: woven ribbons visibly distinguish dependencies, support and review, with changing highlighted thread.
Knowledge stratigraphy: layered type/instance/evidence strata align into readable contextual cross-sections.
Knowledge cabinet: precise physical index leaves, tabs and cards pivot to show class-instance and provenance relations.
Grammar of knowledge: meaningful subject-verb-object tokens assemble into typed statements, with spatial category frames.
private_data: None. Use only the authored examples here.
